1.description: Low-risk group (about 20% diabetic): younger patients with mostly normal blood pressure and cholesterol, good general health, physically active and with higher income.

0.description: Moderate-risk group (about 63% diabetic): older patients with high blood pressure and high cholesterol who still report good physical and mental health and few mobility problems.

2.description: High-risk group (about 76% diabetic): patients with poor general health, many days of poor physical and mental health, difficulty walking, low physical activity, lower income and the highest rates of heart disease and stroke.
